release_blocking: Frozen scientific protocols and all planned archive/control runs retained; comparison and coverage counts match normalized evidence; discrepancies are findings, not pass/fail criteria.
Original artifact bytes stored privately in Supabase Storage, retrieved and SHA256 verified; normalized relational records and published values stored separately.
Every new table has RLS; dedicated public evidence projections permit anonymous reads; browser INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE denied; raw artifact table and bucket private.
Backend module allowlist, authenticated user/module conversation scope, bounded read-only tools, prompt and analysis provenance, deterministic evidence rendering and failed-call accounting tested.
Only a prompt candidate passing the frozen actual-answer evaluation criteria is published; failed evaluations and publication history retained.

Frontend lint, relevant tests and production build pass. Completed and meaningful unavailable/invalid states checked in desktop/mobile browsers, light/dark, charts, exports, navigation and sign-in return paths.
Guarded target identity verification immediately before migrations, prompt publication and deployment; deployment changes limited to this feature and necessary integrations.

conditional.authenticated_chat: Exercise an actual request only if a legitimate Google session is available. Otherwise record that end-to-end signed-in production chat was not verified; unit/auth-denial/model-service checks do not substitute for it.
conditional.new_network_campaign: Historical BGP routes, author hardware, Liberty Global policy and APNIC raw requests unavailable. No fresh empirical network campaign, simulations or causal/generalization validation substituted.
conditional.literature: Incomplete direct-source access and substantive review explicitly displayed; numerical reproduction does not imply full literature review or full paper validation.
conditional.billing: Record returned model tokens and measured byte/time usage. Billing not reconciled: estimates and unallocated/missing costs labeled separately.

production_verification: Check Amplify build success and deployed canonical routes
Inspect deployed desktop/mobile results and themes
Verify public exports and file hashes
Verify deployed backend authenticated capability behavior where legitimate session exists, and anonymous auth denial otherwise
